scope: Power programs only for 2026 season: SEC (16), Big Ten (18), Big 12 (16), ACC (17), Notre Dame (Independent). Total 68. Oregon State and Washington State are Pac-12 / not Power.
valuation_metric: Hypothetical open-market sale price of the football program (The Athletic methodology: revenue multiples by conference tier + brand/demographics/realignment adjustments).
nil_metric_recommendation: Use nil-ncaa.com estimated football roster cost (school rev-share to football + third-party NIL) for 2026-27 — only consistent school-by-school series covering all 68. Do NOT mix with all-sports House cap (~$20.5M in 2025-26 / ~$21.3M in 2026-27) or football-only rev-share (~$13–16M when school-reported).
nil_coverage: 68/68 estimated; 0/68 school-audited football NIL budgets located as a uniform public series.
wsj_brewer_note: WSJ/Ryan Brewer Jan 2026 (2025 season) and Jan 2025 (2024 season) also publish football enterprise values; free secondary coverage typically only top ~20. Not used as primary here because incomplete free Power coverage vs Athletic's full 68.
paywalls: Athletic primary URLs are subscriber-paywalled; numbers verified via free secondary reprints (On3, SI/FanNation, Yahoo/Buffaloes Wire, RawChili mirror).

in_season_movement_recommendation.primary_arrows: Year-over-year Athletic rank change (rank_change_spots) until next Athletic annual update.
in_season_movement_recommendation.optional_estimate: If desired later, clearly labeled 'in-season estimate' separate from published valuation: V_t = V_0 * (1 + 0.015*z(win%) + 0.010*z(attendance) + 0.020*AP_bonus) with |weekly Δ| capped at 2% of V_0 and AP_bonus = max(0, (26-AP_rank)/25) only when ranked. Do not overwrite published valuation_usd.
in_season_movement_recommendation.reason: No official weekly valuation exists; small capped overlay is transparent but risks users treating estimates as fact. Prefer YoY published arrows for v1.
